equal and opposite reaction.vi: phản lực cân bằng, ngược chiều
equal and opposite reaction.definition_en: a force of the same size that pushes in the other direction
equal and opposite reaction.extra_example: When you jump off a boat, the boat moves back — an equal and opposite reaction.
